name: Andrew May
role: Regional Medical Director, Sullivan County Regional Health Department
bio:
Dr. May is a summa cum laude graduate or ETSU, and a cum laude graduate of the UT Center for the Health Sciences with a degree in Medicine. He completed his Family Practice residency in Huntsville where he was awarded most outstanding resident.

Dr May returned to his home town in Elizabethton was in practice with his father for 26 years. He has held many hospital leadership positions to include Chief of Staff, Physician Advisor, and Regional Board member with Mountain States Health Alliance.

Dr. May currently serves as the Regional Medical Director for the Sullivan County Regional Health Department along with Assistant Medical Director for Sullivan County EMS. He also holds assistant professorships with the ETSU College of Medicine and Public Health. He has received many community awards to include the Christian Servant Leadership award and Health Care Hero award. He was also an examiner for the Tennessee Center of Performance Excellence and has assisted Sullivan County in achieving a Level 1 Commitment Award and two Level 3 Achievement Awards.

He has many diversified talents to include music, aviation, and wildlife management loving all things outdoors.

He currently resides in Elizabethton with his wife of 31 years and has 3 children, one completing a PhD in Neurobehavioral Criminology in Tallahassee, Florida, the second works as a Forensic Anthropologist for Charlotte NC, and his youngest daughter a senior at UT Chattanooga graduating in December. He also has 2 grandchildren, Sterling and Scarlett.
